```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Load libraries

```{r}
library(here)
library(dplyr)
```

# Import data

```{r}
data_raw <- read.csv(here::here("datasets", "sound_of_norway", "data", "raw", "sound_of_norway_subsample.csv"))
taxonomy <- read.delim2(
  file = here::here("datasets", "sound_of_norway", "data", "raw", "labels_en.txt"),
  sep = "_",
  header = FALSE,
  col.names = c("scientificName", "englishName")
)
```

## Inspect data

```{r}
# Summarise number of unique values per column in the raw data
data_raw %>%
  dplyr::summarise(dplyr::across(dplyr::everything(), dplyr::n_distinct)) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(dplyr::everything(), names_to = "column", values_to = "n_unique")
```

# Create sample dataset

```{r}
dataset <- 
  dplyr::left_join(data_raw, taxonomy, dplyr::join_by(tags == englishName)) %>% 
  dplyr::rename(englishName = "tags") %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(
    # Parse detected time to datetime object in UTC
    detected_time_parsed = lubridate::ymd_hms(.data$detected_time, tz = "UTC"),
    # Calculate "eventEnd"
    detected_time_end_interim = .data$detected_time_parsed + .data$end_secs,
    # Format event end time to ISO 8601 string
    detected_time_end = format(
      .data$detected_time_end_interim, format = "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%OSZ", tz = "UTC"
      ),
    # Extract interim timestamp from audio file name
    timestamp_interim = sub(".mp3", "", basename(.data$audio_link)),
    # Format timestamp
    timestamp = gsub("_", ":", .data$timestamp_interim) # format %Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%f%z
  )
```

```{r}
dataset <-
  dataset %>% 
  dplyr::select(
    "id", "analysis", "scientificName", "englishName", "start_secs", "end_secs", "confidence", 
    "detected_time", "detected_time_end", "audio_id", "project", "recorder", "site", "latitude",
    "longitude", "audio_link", "timestamp"
  )
```

# Write sample dataset

```{r}
readr::write_csv(dataset, here::here("datasets", "living-data-workshop", "data", "raw", "example_sound_of_norway.csv"), na = "")
```
